em-explorer.description: Explore Event Model using emcli tools

em-author.description: Author Event Model pieces using emcli tools

emcli_connection.description:
Manage connections and field derivations between elements.
Verbs: add (--from --to [--id]), add-derivation (--connection --target --from), remove (--connection), remove-derivation (--connection --target)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_element.description:
Manage elements (commands, events, read models, screens, automations) and their fields.
Verbs: add (--name --kind [--id]), add-field (--element --name --type [--cardinality] [--optional] [--subfield-of]), add-origin (--element --field --origin), context (--element --new-context), delete (--element), image (--element --url), remove-field (--element --name), remove-origin (--element --field), rename (--element --new-name), swimlane (--element --lane)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_placement.description:
Manage element placements within timeline slices.
Verbs: add (--slice --element [--id]), remove (--slice --element), reorder (--slice --element [--position] [--before] [--after])

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_query.description:
Read-only structural query over the Event Model. Answers relational questions - e.g. which slices an element is placed in, which elements an event derives from - and returns only the matching part of the model. Use `emcli_resolve` first if you only have names; this tool never writes.

A query is a root followed by stages separated by `|`, applied left-to-right over a collection.

ROOT (required, first): an entity kind - timeline | swimlane | slice | element | specification | step - or a single entity as `kind:id` (e.g. `element:42`).

RELATION (a target kind, singular or plural accepted; placements and connections are edges, never roots):
  timeline -> slice
  slice -> timeline
  slice -> specification
  specification -> slice
  specification -> step
  step -> specification
  step -> element
  element -> step
  element -> swimlane
  swimlane -> element
  slice -> element   (via placement; project {index})
  element -> slice   (via placement; project {index})
  element -> element   [outgoing]   (via connection; project {derivations})
  element -> element   [incoming]   (via connection; project {derivations})

EDGE PROJECTION `{field,...}`: attach the association record under its key (placement or connection), e.g. `slice:7 | elements {index}` gives each element plus `:placement {:index n}`.

STAGES:
  where <field> = | != | ~ | in <value>   ( ~ = regex, in = set membership )
  order <field> | order -<field>          ( - = descending )
  select <field,...>
  count | limit <n> | distinct

Examples:
  timelines | slice | where status=in_progress | select id,title
  element:42 | slice
  slice:7 | elements {index} | where kind=command
  element:42 | outgoing {derivations}

An invalid stage returns an error naming the valid alternatives. Run `emcli query --relations` for the live list.

query.description: A pipeline, e.g. `element:42 | slice` or `slice:7 | elements {index}`. Root first, then `|`-separated stages; see the tool description for the grammar and relation vocabulary.

emcli_resolve.description: Resolve one or more element/timeline/slice names to their integer ids. Use before authoring commands when you have names but not ids.

queries.description: comma-separated name[:kind_hint] entries, e.g. "Baz:slice,Snaz"; kind_hint is one of timeline|swimlane|slice|element|specification and only ranks candidates, never filters them

emcli_slice.description:
Manage slices (vertical time segments) within a timeline.
Verbs: add (--timeline --title --kind --index [--id]), delete (--slice), kind (--slice --new-kind), reorder (--slice --new-index), status (--slice --new-status)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_spec.description:
Manage specifications attached to slices.
Verbs: add (--slice --title [--id]), delete (--spec)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_step.description:
Manage steps and examples within a specification.
Verbs: add (--spec --clause --element --index [--id]), add-example (--step --field-name --field-value), error (--spec --error-name --index [--id]), expect-empty (--step --value), remove (--step), remove-example (--step --field-name)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_swimlane.description:
Manage swimlanes (horizontal rows) in the event model.
Verbs: add (--name --index [--id]), delete (--lane), rename (--lane --new-name), reorder (--lane --new-index)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_timeline.description:
Manage timelines (vertical swim-lane columns) in the event model.
Verbs: add (--title [--id]), delete (--timeline), rename (--timeline --new-title)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.

emcli_validate.description: Run Event Model validation and return all warnings and errors.

emcli_wireframe.description:
Manage wireframe node trees on screen elements and display them.
Verbs: add-node (--element --tag [--text] [--parent]), add-node-before (--element --before --tag [--text]), delete-node (--element --node), set-attr (--element --node --attr --value), set-text (--element --node --text), show (--element)

args.description: Space-separated --flag value pairs for the chosen verb. Optional flags may be omitted.
